# Three.js

Version: 0.186.1 (r186), MIT license in LICENSE.
Minified published build files from https://www.npmjs.com/package/three/v/0.186.1
Downloaded from jsDelivr's pinned npm distribution on 2026-10-20.

Only the two relative imports in the module build were changed from three.core.js to the adjacent three.core.min.js. Both files are served
locally and included in the app shell cache; the landing page does not fetch a CDN.
Only the decorative public home scene uses these modules.
